budget_items.topic: Demolition cost estimates for Passios, old Primary School and Brooks House
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Public commenter Dave MacDonald cited estimates for tearing down the three municipal buildings, totalling over $1.25 million.
budget_items.quote: if you want to tear down passios, it will cost the town $1+ million based on estimates from two years ago.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave MacDonald cited a report estimate for remodelling the Ritter Building, which he said was not a full remodel.
budget_items.quote: to remodel ritter would be between $2.5 and $3 million and that is not a full remodel.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave MacDonald cited a 2013 engineering estimate for renovating Town Hall.
budget_items.quote: to renovate town hall, an engineering estimate from 2013 quoted $2.1 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Meeting approved $90,000 to paint Town Hall, per Dave MacDonald's public comment.
budget_items.quote: at this past town meeting, the town approved $90,000 to paint town hall which he supports.

budget_items.topic: Casella dumpster disposal for Town Hall records clean-out
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager reported the approximate disposal cost for the Casella dumpster at Town Hall.
budget_items.quote: the approximate cost for disposal will be $700.00.

budget_items.topic: Regional animal shelter grant transferred to Lunenburg
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A grant of $42,257 for design and construction of a regional animal shelter was awarded and is now led by Lunenburg.
budget_items.quote: was awarded $42,257 for the design and construction of a regional animal shelter.

budget_items.topic: Compost bin and rain barrel pricing and grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A proposed reduced price of $80.00 for buying a compost bin and rain barrel together, supported by a $5,400 annual grant.
budget_items.quote: we would like to offer a reduced price if we sell both items at the same time for $80.00

budget_items.topic: Land Use electrical and plumbing permit fees for the Unifier Roots event
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fees for electrical and plumbing permits, not in the fee schedule, were recommended at $150.00 each as a one-time amendment.
budget_items.quote: it was recommended the fees be set at $150.00 each.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed four warrants: accounts payable, payroll, payroll deductions and a Middle/High School project warrant.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $223,297.13, a payroll warrant in the amount of

budget_items.topic: Cost to operate municipal buildings after Passios move-out
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town will monitor the cost to operate the Passios and other municipal buildings after FLAAC moves out.
budget_items.quote: going forward we will be monitoring the cost to operate the passios and other municipal buildings.

budget_items.topic: Federal and state budget effects on health care and transportation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Representative Benson said that without federal Medicaid funding the state could lose possibly a billion dollars from the health care budget.
budget_items.quote: without that funding we are looking at possibly a billion dollars leaving the state budget that supports health care.

budget_items.topic: FY17 quarterly report: Reserve Fund and salary line reductions
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reserve Fund reduced, Town Manager salary line reduced and a small audit-line surplus recorded for FY17.
budget_items.quote: the reserve fund was reduced by $98,000, town manager salary line was reduced by $7,000

budget_items.topic: FY17 quarterly report: Council on Aging budget increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Council on Aging budget increased due to MART reimbursement and contract changes.
budget_items.quote: we increased the council on aging budget by $3,100 due to changes in the mart reimbursement process

budget_items.topic: FY17 quarterly report: animal control officer budget increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Animal control officer budget increased for extended care of two abused pit bulls.
budget_items.quote: we increased the animal control officer budget by $6,100 due to extended care of two abused pit bulls.

budget_items.topic: FY17 quarterly report: Monty Tech assessment surplus
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A surplus in the Monty Tech assessment is expected at fiscal year close.
budget_items.quote: there is going to be a surplus in the monty tech assessment of $9,209 at the close of the fiscal year

budget_items.topic: FY17 quarterly report: snow removal supplemental appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A supplemental appropriation for snow removal was made at town meeting, with a small DPW deficit remaining.
budget_items.quote: in snow removal we did a supplemental appropriation of $166,000 at town meeting.

budget_items.topic: FY17 quarterly report: veterans, health insurance and unemployment reductions
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Veterans benefits, health insurance and unemployment lines were reduced at annual town meeting, offsetting snow and ice deficit.
budget_items.quote: veterans benefits were reduced by $45,000 at annual town meeting.
